reviews.text: I just used them to replace screens in my lanai. Very competitive pricing. Extremely well run company. Office staff is on the ball and very responsive which i found very refreshing. Francisco was my tech and he was very helpful. I was very satisfied with  every aspect of the job. Two thumbs up😀
reviews.author: Rich A

reviews.text: Phoenix Screen Company was fantastic to work with! They were prompt, did a great job, and the quality of their work really shows. Communication was clear and consistent throughout the entire process, which made everything smooth and stress-free. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Ed Thompson

reviews.text:
It’s rare these days to find a company that delivers quality,  great service & competitive pricing, but they nailed it. From the estimate for my pool screen replacement to the finished project, their professionalism & efficiency completely exceeded my expectations!!!!!!

Thank you Francisco ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.author: Reyna Hernandez

reviews.text: The best! Amazing service. Very professional. They helped me fix my screen and pointed out other issues I hadn’t noticed. 100% recommend them
reviews.author: ariana vila

reviews.text: Great service, very professional and friendly staff. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Roger Paulino

reviews.text:
Great job replacing my screens. Scott is very knowledgeable and trustworthy.
Quality work and reasonable price.  I can't say enough about this business along with is crew of very nice people.  I will use them in the future if needed.
reviews.author: Pamela Capitano

reviews.text: Owner of Phoenix Screen Company Scott Schwartz does phenomenal work and is a perfectionist in his field. Licensed and insured. Rates that are fair and upfront. There are no hidden costs with Scott.   Proactive remediation suggestions to minimize future repairs. Scott demonstrated that he was not out for the almighty dollar & a quick job when he suggested we might want to wait until after hurricane season to do our repairs. Glad we did, because our area was hit by freak 60+ mph winds which necessitated replacing all the screens! Scott also repaired our screen doors and checked our gutters as well. Our screen enclosure looks brand new again. I highly recommend Scott and Phoenix Screen without hesitation. 100% Satisfied!
reviews.author: Rosie Service

reviews.text: Did a Great job at my mom’s pool patio rescreen. She was very happy with their services.
reviews.author: Jose Deleon

authentic_signals: Specific details in several reviews (lanai, pool screen, crew names Francisco/Scott)
